body:
@mthuret

For the time being, I actually am going to keep my current component structure and created a temporary object container in `SiteSearch` to remember the `query` from `searchState` when `ShowMoreResults` unmounts and to merge in that query only if it exists. I then set it back to `null` afterwards as I use it as an indicator that I'm coming from the `ShowMoreResults` view.

Seems to work and I'll keep investigating and testing out some of the suggestions you made above to see if that could replace what I have now.

Thanks!
